title: Light Hammer +1
summary: +1 light hammer that can be thrown or used for Concussive Smash.

fields.Damage: 1d4 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength. +1 to attack rolls. Simple one-handed melee weapon, 5 ft reach. Light, Thrown and Dippable.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action, melee weapon damage. Constitution save or Dazed for 2 turns. The action uses the higher of weapon-action DC +2 and spell save DC. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by traders that use the magic melee weapon table.
fields.Base value: 40 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
